description: Pearland Plaza is a well-established Kroger-anchored community shopping center strategically located at 3205-3287 East Broadway Street in Pearland, Texas. This 156,491 square foot retail destination serves as a vital community hub, featuring a strong mix of national retailers including Kroger as the grocery anchor, Walgreens pharmacy, Harbor Freight Tools, Goodwill, and Advance Auto Parts. The center benefits from exceptional visibility with over 29,000 vehicles passing daily on East Broadway Street, and its proximity to Pearland Regional Airport and Pearland High School with over 3,000 students ensures consistent foot traffic throughout the day. The tenant mix thoughtfully balances essential services with specialty offerings, including Lila's Mexican Restaurant, Hollywood Hair salon, Huntington Learning Centers, and Gracie Barra Pearland martial arts studio, creating a one-stop destination for the community's daily needs. Serving one of Houston's most affluent suburban markets with average household incomes exceeding $133,000 within 3 miles, Pearland Plaza has established itself as a cornerstone retail destination in this rapidly growing area of Brazoria County.
